title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Adjustment Relief: How Much Is Posted Now
content:
**Rule (TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve).** How much of the recall adjustment relief is posted now follows the plan's state: where the plan has ended, the whole relief is posted now; where the plan is in force, it is posted now up to what that adjustment bill still owes; otherwise nothing is posted now.

**When has the plan ended, and when is it in force?** A plan has ended when its status is terminated by request, terminated for nonpayment or terminated for ineligibility; it is in force when its status is active; "otherwise" is any other status, such as applied or rejected. What the adjustment bill still owes is the amount billed as adjustment less the payments and the credits already standing against that bill, never below zero.

**The plan is active and the adjustment bill still owes 50.00; the relief figured is 110.67.** 50.00 is posted now.

**The plan was terminated for ineligibility; the relief figured is 110.67.** The whole 110.67 is posted now.

**The plan is still applied.** Nothing is posted now.
